claims.text: Amazon reported full-year 2024 operating income of $68.6 billion and Q4 2024 operating income of $21.2 billion; these are different reporting periods.
Amazon net sales declined sequentially from $187.8 billion in Q4 2024 to $155.7 billion in Q1 2025.
Amazon reported net income of $59.2 billion in Q4 2024.
Amazon disclosed AWS standalone free cash flow of $8.0 billion for Q1 2025.
Marvell GAAP net income decreased from $200.2 million in Q4 FY2025 to $177.9 million in Q1 FY2026.
Marvell non-GAAP net income increased from $531.4 million in Q4 FY2025 to $540.0 million in Q1 FY2026.
Marvell reported GAAP net income of $540.0 million in Q1 FY2026.
Marvell disclosed GAAP net profit of $50.0 million specifically for its custom AI silicon product line in Q1 FY2026.
Amazon reported net income of $17.1 billion in Q1 2025.
AWS operating income increased from $10.6 billion in Q4 2024 to $11.5 billion in Q1 2025, a calculated increase of $0.9 billion using rounded figures.
亚马逊 2025 年第一季度净销售额为 187.8 billion USD。
Amazon disclosed a standalone Trainium operating margin of 25% for Q1 2025.
Marvell reported GAAP diluted EPS of $0.20 and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $0.62 for Q1 FY2026.
Using Marvell Q1 FY2026 reported diluted EPS, non-GAAP EPS exceeded GAAP EPS by a calculated $0.42 per share.
Marvell 在 Q1 FY2026 披露的 GAAP gross margin 为 59.8%。
Marvell disclosed a standalone custom AI silicon operating margin of 45% in Q1 FY2026.
NVIDIA Data Center revenue rose from $35.6 billion in Q4 FY2025 to $39.1 billion in Q1 FY2026, a calculated increase of $3.5 billion using rounded figures.
NVIDIA Q1 FY2026 GAAP net income was $18,775 million, while non-GAAP net income was $19,894 million.
英伟达 Q1 FY2026 披露的 GAAP diluted EPS 为 0.89 USD。
As of May 31, 2025, NVIDIA had reported actual Q2 FY2026 revenue of $45.0 billion.
